traceability.notes: All acceptance-criteria aspects of 002.0-DEV-ESLINT-CONFIG are implemented and verified: - Core presets (recommended and strict) are provided, exported, and tested. - ESLint v9 flat config is used correctly in eslint.config.js, with best-practice patterns reinforced by dedicated configuration guides. - Integration with various project types (JS, TS, mixed, monorepo) is documented and validated via CLI integration tests using the real flat config. - Rule options and configuration validation (including customizable storyDirectories and strict schema with additionalProperties=false) are implemented and covered by Jest tests tied to this story. - User-facing and internal documentation provide configuration examples and a troubleshooting guide for ESLint configuration issues. - Tests for configuration loading/validation are present, and the Jest suite runs without reported failures. Therefore this story is assessed as fully implemented and passing.
